title: Alcoa Corp 8-K Filing — 2026-04-14
summary: Alcoa Corporation announced through an 8-K filing that its subsidiary Alcoa Nederland Holding B.V. will redeem all $218.7 million of its outstanding 6.125% Notes due 2028 on May 15, 2026, at par plus accrued interest. This is a scheduled optional redemption at 100% of principal.
key_points: Alcoa Nederland Holding B.V., a wholly-owned subsidiary of Alcoa Corporation, provided notice of election to redeem all outstanding notes on April 14, 2026
Redemption price: 100.000% of principal plus accrued and unpaid interest
Notes are guaranteed on a senior unsecured basis by the Company and certain subsidiaries

The redemption at par represents an optional call that the company is exercising—likely refinancing at more favorable rates or managing debt maturity profile. The size ($218.7 million) is relatively small relative to Alcoa's capital structure and unlikely to have meaningful market-wide implications.
